Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL5725546. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
